recipes.name: Tuna Melts
ingredients_raw: 1 small sweet onion, peeled and diced

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a mixing bowl, combine sweet onion, drained tuna, mozzarella, and mayonnaise. Mix thoroughly.
Spread tuna mixture on slices of French bread to form a sandwich. Place sandwiches on a cookie sheet.
Bake in a preheated oven for 10 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Tuna Melts
raw_recipe.description: A cheesy tuna sandwich with onion and melted mozzarella.

video.description: You've got to try this recipe for delicious melted cheesy tuna sandwiches. These flavorful tuna melts are quick and easy to make.

review.reviewBody: YUM! But seriously, 1 cup of mayo? I used 2 tablespoons. 4 stars because if I would have used 1 cup of mayo, I'm positive this would have been inedible. I omitted the onions, added a shake of garlic salt, and a little dill relish. I've never tried mozzarella on a tuna melt before, but it was awesome. Thank you!

Oh my goodness, this was delicious!! What's great is there are so many different ways to tweak it to suit your taste. I reduced the mayo and added a couple tablespoons of pickle relish and a few chopped up hard-boiled eggs (mom's recipe). Instead of French bread, I got a loaf of garlic bread from the bakery and grilled it face down for about 5 minutes to get it toasty. I then layered slices of mozzarella on the bread, added the tuna salad and then topped with provolone slices and put it back on the grill for about 8 minutes. Everyone LOVED it!! Can't wait to make this again. I might add bacon and tomato slices too. :-)

Great, but needs some modifications:
Cut the mayo big time. Like 2-3 TBS
I added about 1 1/2 stalks of chopped celery
garlic powder
A few TBS of horseradish
Salt and pepper
I also added a slice of Colby jack cheese on the top for extra cheese.
When I baked it I put it on a pizza stone for added crunch to the bottom of the bread. 
It was really great with more flavor and added zing.

The recipe itself and all the suggestions are great! But my late husband’s recipe was a little more flavorful. Add to this mix (less mayo, of course!) ??, some breadcrumbs and make into a patty. Heat in a skillet on both sides. You can use a little butter or cooking spray, put on the bread top w/ cooked bacon and Swiss cheese and place in oven until browned! Yummy!,

This is great. Like others, I used half the mayo. I also used brioche buns, fresh chopped red peppers, garlic salt, fresh ground black pepper, and slivered almonds on the top. I also broiled them for a couple minutes to get that perfect light-toasted look and taste. Next time, I think I’ll experiment with a dash of ground red pepper, basil, or a little Cholula hot sauce.
I added a little red onion, cherry/cranberry/pecan mix. I toasted English muffins lightly, afded tuna mixture & mozzarella cheese, absolutely delicious

I made them yesterday, coincidentally! my recipe is very similar but has more ingredients. I drain one large can of pineapple tidbits. drain well & set aside. to the above recipe I add abt 1 tsp. shredded cherry peppers in a jar, and abt 1/4 C sweet cucumber relish, plus a plentiful shake of season-all. Mix well everything except pineapple. Add well drained tidbits (or crushed: drained), Carefully fold into tuna. I use chibatta rolls, split & toasted, top with provolone slices or whatever tickles your fancy . 375 degree oven 15 min.

I made this but doubled the tuna, half the Mayo, added a dash of garlic powder and pepper. I also added a 1/4 cup of French dressing and a bit more chopped onion. I spread mixture on slices of homemade bread. I then laid a slice of American cheese on top and baked them.

Family loved them!

I added diced celery, onions, mayo and a touch Italian dressing, spread it on bread toasted it, added a slice of mozzarella cheese and under broiler a to melt that cheese to. With a green salad-Supper.

Great recipe!! It's so much easier to put it in the oven, that I now use it for other sandwiches. For this recipe, I added chopped dill pickles, pickle juice and other spices that we like. As with any recipe I always make it my own. I like to find recipes that have a great base. I probably added a cup of mayo cause we love mayo. This is a great base recipe for tuna melts. I would have normally use sour dough, but the french roll was much better and easier.

loved it nice comfort food,, great with shot soups or cries, I did cut the French bread in half add a tomatoes on the top and placed a sli e of mozzarella. cheese on top as well, then put the top bread on top a little olive oil on crust and backed until cheese melted
Very good. I kept adding time in 3.5 minute increments till the cheese was slightly brown. I also served them open-faced.

I forgot to mention besides tomatoes not mentioned in the recipe but was in your video whatever you sprinkled onto the tomatoes wasn't in the recipe also. I used a mixed salad seasoning ingredients on top of the tomatoes and it was very good!
Great recipe. Simple ingredients and easy to make.
I have to say I had my doubts about this. Tuna and mozz?
I added celery because I like it in tuna. I topped them with a slice of Muenster cheese and will also add a tomato slice next time. The cheese and onion added a lot of flavor to these.
We enjoyed it because it was something different for lunch. I used an 11oz package of tuna and 1/2 cup mayonnaise I too think 1 cup mayonnaise would have been to much.
Based on other reviews I just made my usual tuna salad with enough mayo to bind it. It was still pretty bland. Will keep looking for more interesting tuna melt recipes
Pleased the whole family! Cooked for 12 mins and used shredded Parmesan instead of Mozzarella and it was just as Delicious!!
